CameraLiveApi: Tapo live view of the phones (Android, the Quest, iPhone and iPad): the computers play the stream through libmpv in DesktopCameraLiveView (lib/desktop/video/camera_live_view.dart) and never call it
DjiLinkApi: DJI link diagnostics, Android phones and the Meta Quest build only: djiLinkSupportedProvider answers false off Android, so the page and its tile never show on the computers
DocumentTreeApi: DJI drone page, Android phones only: droneImportSupportedProvider answers false off Android, so the page and its tile never show on the computers
ImmersiveApi: Meta Quest immersive viewer: isHorizonOsProvider answers false off Android before calling it
QrScanApi: QR code scanner of Connect a TV or computer (sign in with your phone), phones and tablets only: the Settings card and the Connect page are not offered on the big screens (isBigScreenProvider is true on every computer), which are signed in, not signing in
TvApi: Android TV: readTvDeviceInfo answers "not a TV" off Android before calling it
